_notes: Address form, Agency console: impersonal by construction (infinitives for instructions, nominal labels, 'il team' / 'in carico' instead of 'tu'); the existing informal 'tu' prose (…che segui, a tuo nome, ti servono) was rewritten. Button and menu labels keep the conventional Italian UI imperative (Salva, Invia, Apri), which is register-neutral.

Address form, University console: impersonal / third person ('l'università', 'l'ufficio', 'lo staff Hangyul'); the earlier mixed 'voi' (la vostra università, avete confermato) and 'tu' (il tuo account) were removed. No 'Lei' was needed anywhere once phrasing is impersonal.

Gender neutrality (V31 open item): singular statuses, chips and sentences that described one student or the reader with a masculine default were rewritten to be neutral by construction (Da inviare, Candidatura inviata, Ammissione negata o ritiro, Risposta dovuta, 'chi lascia il team', 'la persona candidata'). Generic plural group labels ('studenti', 'ammessi', 'iscritti', 'candidati') are kept as the unmarked Italian plural (otherwise the stage strip becomes unreadable); role titles ('amministratore', 'revisore') kept as functional labels — both flagged for the owner.
'You' as the current user in lists (docs.you, team.you, settings.youShort) is rendered 'io' / 'Io', the convention Italian productivity tools use for the signed-in user.
Offer = 'ammissione' (Ammissione comunicata / accettata; Tasso di ammissione), consistent with the marketing/common patch; 'offerta' in Italian reads as a commercial deal.
Standard admission letter = 'lettera di ammissione standard', once glossed '(standard admission letter)' in agency:ws.noVisaText; the University action is 'Emetti lettera di ammissione standard'.

Document review = 'verifica' (Coda di verifica, Verifica documenti, in verifica, da verificare); 'revisione' is reserved for essay review. Audit log = 'registro di audit' (replacing 'registro di controllo') to match common:nav.audit.

Official admission guide = 'bando' (bando ufficiale / bando di ammissione), the natural Italian term; caseload = 'in carico'; Hangyul HQ = 'Sede Hangyul'; Hangyul Operations = 'Operazioni Hangyul' (matches common:role); Insights = 'Statistiche' (university:v28.pipe.label said 'Analisi').

Plurals: every _one/_other family received the noun in both forms (e.g. {{count}} documento da correggere / documenti da correggere); 'and {{count}} more' is 'e {{count}} in più' so both forms read correctly.
